routes.warnForbiddenMessage: The System Administration area (/admin) is reserved for Platform Administrators (Admin / Super Admin). Please use the Organization Dashboard (/dashboard).
routes.forbiddenMessage: The System Administration area (/admin) is restricted to Platform Administrators (Admin / Super Admin). Organization users and operators should work within the Business Dashboard.

401.title: Your session has expired.
401.message: Your authentication token is no longer valid. Please sign in again with your account to continue.
401.imageAlt: SelfHeal Bot scanning an expired authentication badge

403.title: Access denied.
403.message: Your account does not have permission to access this page or resource under current RBAC policies.
403.imageAlt: SelfHeal Bot standing in front of a locked security gate

404.title: This is not the page you are looking for.
404.message: This resource or route does not exist on the system or has been relocated.
404.imageAlt: SelfHeal Bot searching with a magnifying glass

500.title: Internal server error encountered.
500.message: The system experienced an unexpected failure. The SelfHeal AI Agent is collecting logs for automated diagnostics.
500.imageAlt: SelfHeal Bot inspecting a malfunctioning server rack

503.title: Service temporarily unavailable.
503.message: The cluster is undergoing autonomous recovery or temporary overload. Please check back in a few moments.
503.imageAlt: SelfHeal Bot repairing the server cluster with a wrench

429.title: Too many requests at once.
429.message: Rate limiting is temporarily throttling requests to protect cluster service stability.
429.imageAlt: SelfHeal Bot surrounded by incoming request packets

agent-offline.title: Attempting to reconnect with Agent.
agent-offline.message: No heartbeat received from the SelfHeal Agent in your Kubernetes cluster. Please check Pod status or network connectivity.
agent-offline.imageAlt: SelfHeal Bot reconnecting the Agent signal cable

cluster-lost.title: Cluster node synchronization lost.
cluster-lost.message: The Kubernetes cluster is temporarily unresponsive. The platform is re-establishing API Server connectivity.
cluster-lost.imageAlt: SelfHeal Bot reconnecting disconnected Kubernetes nodes

monitoring.title: Inspecting live telemetry stream.
monitoring.message: SelfHeal Bot is continuously monitoring real-time Kubernetes CPU, RAM, and cluster latency metrics.
monitoring.imageAlt: SelfHeal Bot checking the live telemetry waveform screen

maintenance.title: Scheduled system maintenance in progress.
maintenance.message: Our engineering team and SelfHeal Bot are upgrading infrastructure. Services will resume shortly.
maintenance.imageAlt: SelfHeal Bot wearing an engineer hard hat during maintenance
